changeSet.author: Gregory Bliault
changeSet.sql:
DO $$ DECLARE rename_spec text[]; BEGIN FOREACH rename_spec SLICE 1 IN ARRAY ARRAY[ ARRAY['specimen', 'fk_specimen_category', 'fk_specimen_type'], ARRAY['specimen_aud', 'fk_specimen_category', 'fk_specimen_type'], ARRAY['siamois_document', 'fk_category', 'fk_type'], ARRAY['siamois_document_aud', 'fk_category', 'fk_type'], ARRAY['spatial_unit', 'fk_concept_category_id', 'fk_concept_type_id'], ARRAY['spatial_unit_aud', 'fk_concept_category_id', 'fk_concept_type_id'] ] LOOP IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = rename_spec[1] AND column_name = rename_spec[2]) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = rename_spec[1] AND column_name = rename_spec[3]) THEN EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %I RENAME COLUMN %I TO %I', rename_spec[1], rename_spec[2], rename_spec[3]); END IF; END LOOP; END $$;
-- -409: find type, -201: place type, -101: project type (it shared the find label), -704: document type UPDATE custom_field SET label = 'specimen.field.type', value_binding = 'type' WHERE custom_field_id IN (-409, -201) AND is_system_field; UPDATE custom_field SET label = 'specimen.field.type' WHERE custom_field_id = -101 AND is_system_field; UPDATE custom_field SET label = 'document.field.type', value_binding = 'type' WHERE custom_field_id = -704 AND is_system_field;
